briefing: Prom grew the most: its total value went from $96.0M to $107.3M, up 11.7% in 24 hours.
Across the 296 Binance coins worth between $15M and $2B, 29 grew and 267 shrank — a weak day.
Lagrange's market cap jumped 73.2%, but its price moved only -6.4% — more coins are now counted in circulation, so the jump didn't come from buyers. We tag these “New supply”.
